recommendation_summary: For now, the reply says to use the existing shared list as the preparation queue: unmade cakes due today go at the top, later pickup dates follow, and staff prepare from the top down. It also says to stop the Odoo rollout. It suggests no optional additions and leaves no needs unmet.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked for an Odoo sales, inventory, and manufacturing sync so no pickup is missed, because other shops are moving and a partner is booked next week. What you need is every cake due today prepared before pickup. Payments and stock already reconcile, so those modules are not required for that.
labels.Deleted: Odoo and the implementation partner. The shared order list already has customer, pickup date, and preparation status, and everyone preparing cakes can read it at the counter.
labels.Bottleneck: Cakes due today were still unmade while orders entered later for next month had been prepared. Work is not taken in pickup-date order.
labels.Checked myself: Your account of the shared list, correct payment and stock reconciliation, this morning's missed same-day cakes, and that preparers can read the list at the counter.

note: The reply puts the existing list in due-today-first order and rejects Odoo by name, and its checks rely only on facts the user supplied.
